novelty_flags.label: Theorem 3 (chen-reduction)
novelty_flags.one_line: The statement intentionally reproduces the static LP aggregation and rank result already supplied by ChenSimchiLeviXiong2026, so it should be a sanity corollary rather than a novelty-bearing root target.

novelty_flags.label: ChenSimchiLeviXiong2026 comparison in Theorem 3, related_work, and comparator table
novelty_flags.one_line: The cited arXiv v1 source places the weak-shadow LP result at Section 3.2, Proposition 4—not Section 3.1, Theorem 3.2—although its substantive static LP and full-rank claim is close to the stated comparison.

soundness_flags.label: ass:weak-shadow
soundness_flags.one_line: The cited static weak-shadow source and the closest sequential OPE source state exclusions conditional on outcome plus observed covariates/current state-action, not this full latent-history indexed condition; retag it novel and justify its substantive plausibility.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 3 (chen-reduction)
soundness_flags.one_line: Its cellwise response-positivity premise is introduced inside the theorem but is absent from the declared assumptions, despite being needed for the claimed proportional representation.

soundness_flags.label: Theorem 4 (whole-set-coverage)
soundness_flags.one_line: The coverage and image-containment core follows directly from the exact multinomial quantile definition and p∈C_{n,alpha} implying Theta_I(p)⊆union_{p'∈C_{n,alpha}}Theta_I(p); it is not a standalone substantive theorem.

soundness_flags.label: Open-ended Question 2 (hausdorff-frontier)
soundness_flags.one_line: “The largest compact class” is not a defined unique object: compact compatible-law subclasses are generally incomparable, so the uniformity domain and structural margins governing kappa must be specified.

source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper defines a weak shadow by F ⟂ R | Y,X; equation (2) is the cellwise LP A_x w_x=beta_x, and Proposition 4 gives the aggregated sharp interval and full-column-rank point-identification condition.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 8, Assumption 1; pp. 10–11, equation (2) and Theorem 1
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The revised source still defines the exclusion as F ⟂ R | Y,X and states the static LP/rank result as Theorem 1, confirming that it does not document the proposal's history-indexed sequential condition under its cited name.

The sequential paper assumes S_{t+1} ⟂ O_t | R_t,S_t,A_t plus an augmented Markov model and completeness, then point-identifies value by bridge functions; its target policy depends on previous missingness indicators, not latent rewards.
The proceedings paper studies monotone missingness, proposes an inverse-probability-weighted value estimator under nonignorable missingness, and conducts inference.
The paper proves robust finite- and infinite-horizon DP results when the set of conditional measures has a rectangularity property.

source_verification_receipts.version: Journal of the American Statistical Association 119(547), 2024
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The article reduces discrete causal questions to polynomial programs and uses dual relaxation and spatial branch-and-bound to return sharp bounds or certified non-sharp outer ranges.
The paper constructs criterion-level confidence sets for full identified sets and subvectors, including exact or valid asymptotic coverage in regular, cone, and some singular settings.
The paper proposes bootstrap calibrated projection confidence intervals for components and smooth functions of partially identified parameters in moment-(in)equality models.
The paper studies root-n inference for strongly identified continuous linear functionals despite weakly identified nuisance functions.
The paper establishes a necessary-and-sufficient condition for static MNAR mean-functional identification with a shadow variable even when the joint distribution is not identified.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Retag ass:weak-shadow as novel, state a substantive temporal data-generating justification for conditioning on complete past reward history, and add a comparison showing why the weaker current-state exclusion in WeiQuMiao2026 is insufficient for the target fiber.
Move the Chen static result to an explicitly labeled sanity corollary and correct every anchor to arXiv v1 Section 3.2, Proposition 4 (or pin and quote the exact intended version).

Replace the whole-set containment theorem with a nontrivial finite-sample result about the certified optimizer, such as a stated termination/complexity guarantee or a quantitatively derived component-recovery bound over a named regular stratum.
Replace “largest compact class” in the Hausdorff OEQ by a named margin-indexed semialgebraic law class and ask for kappa as an explicit function of the specified Łojasiewicz and cell-mass constants.
